title: (See DPU 23-45 for related § 72 petition) Petition of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid Pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 69J for Approval to Construct, Operate and Maintain a New Double Circuit Overhead Transmission Line and Two Associated Tap Lines. The Company proposes to replace an existing double circuit transmission line, tap lines, and structures with a new double circuit overhead transmission line, tap lines, and structures in an existing transmission corridor in Warwick, Royalston, Athol, Winchendon, Gardner, Westminster, Fitchburg, Leominster, and Sterling, Massachusetts.

On behalf of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid, attached to the link below please find the Company’s Petitions pursuant to G.L. c. 164 §72 with the Department of Public Utilities (D.P.U. 23-45) and pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 69J seeking approval from the Energy Facilities Siting Board (EFSB 23-02) to construct, operate and maintain a proposed new double circuit overhead transmission line in Warwick, Royalston, Winchendon, Gardner, Westminster, Fitchburg, Leominster and Sterling and two associated tap lines in Athol, Royalston and Gardner that will replace an existing transmission line and tap lines in the same rights-of-way. The Company also plans to remove the existing transmission lines and existing tap lines, and to construct, reestablish and improve access routes. This work is referred to herein as “the Project.”
